characters.name: Amy
characters.clothing: <Subject 1> wears a rough‑stitched brown leather apron that hangs loosely over her waistcoat. The waistcoat is made of coarse wool in a muted tan hue, buttoned at the front and cinched at the back with a simple iron belt. A wooden mug rests on a brass ring attached to her belt for quick service. Over her shoulder drapes a linen cloth used for wiping mugs, its color matching the apron’s brown. She wears sturdy leather boots dyed dark brown, laced up to mid‑calf, suitable for standing long hours in a medieval tavern. No headwear is mentioned; she keeps her hair pulled back into a simple knot at the nape of her neck
